name: @orbb/databox
description: DataBox boundary for ORBB (architecture §6, §7): evidence upload-session orchestration over an injected ObjectStore, S3-compatible R2 object-store adapter with hand-rolled SigV4 presigning (shape-verified, not live-verified), and application-layer envelope encryption behind a KeyProvider interface (development SecretKeyProvider via node:crypto AES-256-GCM). No aws-sdk dependency by recorded decision.
